workflows.name: standard_flowgraph_analysis
workflows.intent: Perform standard differential cell population analysis on flow cytometry cell count data using SpecEnr.
input: count (sample x cell population numeric matrix of cell counts)
meta (data frame with sample metadata, containing an 'id' column matching row names of count)
workflows.stages: 1. Initialize the flowGraph object using flowGraph. ;; 2. Retrieve sample metadata and features using fg_get_meta and fg_get_feature. ;; 3. Calculate summary statistics using fg_summary. ;; 4. Retrieve summary statistics using fg_get_summary. ;; 5. Save and load the flowGraph object using fg_save and fg_load. ;; 6. Visualize results using fg_plot, plot_gr, fg_plot_qq, fg_plot_box, and fg_plot_pVSdiff.
workflows.code:
fg <- flowGraph(fg_data_pos2$count, meta=fg_data_pos2$meta, no_cores=no_cores)
meta <- fg_get_meta(fg)
mcount <- fg_get_feature(fg, "node", "count")
fg_sum <- fg_get_summary(fg, type="node", summary_meta=list(
    node_feature="SpecEnr", 
    test_name="t_diminish", 
    class="class", 
    labels=c("exp","control"))
)
fg_save(fg, "path/to/user/specified/folder/directory")
fg <- fg_load("path/to/user/specified/folder/directory")
meta_new <- fg_get_meta(fg)
meta_new$id[1] <- "new_sample_id1"
fg <- fg_replace_meta(fg, meta_new)
mc <- fg_get_feature(fg, type="node", feature="count")
fg <- fg_add_feature(fg, type="node", feature="count_copy", m=mc)
fg <- fg_rm_feature(fg, type="node", feature="count_copy")
fg <- fg_summary(fg, no_cores=no_cores, class="class", label1="control",
                 node_features="count", edge_features="NONE",
                 overwrite=FALSE, test_name="t", diminish=FALSE)
gr <- fg_plot(fg, index=1, p_thres=.01, show_bgedges=TRUE)
plot_gr(gr, interactive=TRUE)
fg_plot_qq(fg, type="node", index=1)
fg_plot_box(fg, type="node", summary_meta=NULL, index=1, node_edge="A+")
fg_plot_pVSdiff(fg, type="node", summary_meta=NULL, index=1)
